QUOTE: The user opens the failed-post bottom sheet and taps "Try Again" (`app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx:46-49`), which calls `retryFailedPost` (`app/actions/remote/post.ts:228-307`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says retry is manual via the user tapping "Try Again" on the failed post, which calls `retryFailedPost`, and that there is no automatic retry.
